title: Fix some issues seen with cppcheck

notes.body: the pinfo is modified wih get_http_conversation_data ? (do you really need to call this function if you don't use the return value ?)

`get_http_conversation_data` creates the conversation (based off the addresses in pinfo) if it doesn't exist, and creates the initial http conversation data and attaches it to the conversation if it doesn't exist.

However, the next line calls `dissect_http_tls`, which immediately calls `get_http_conversation_data` again, so you're right, it's not necessary.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/8922/diffs?diff_id=539785206&start_sha=9f9a74f1bc0b59f88e4cb6ac71a9b0e7b69174cd#91141fe8031a8b6c0d94c5cbea195c97ee2bdc4d_3985_3985)
